purpose.dashboard: The morning screen: the money of the day and the work waiting for you.
purpose.orders: Every order from the moment it is placed until it is delivered or returned.
purpose.products: The catalogue the shop sells; stock is read from the ERP.
purpose.customers: Everyone who bought or asked, their orders, notes and consent.
purpose.delivery: Couriers, parcels, zones and delivery charges.
purpose.messages: Every message the shop sends: the order journey, campaigns, templates and the log.
purpose.support: Answer every customer on every channel (the Inbox); money complaints with proof.
purpose.rules: Your shop rules in one place: what the shop does by itself, what customers are told, and the Eid dates.
purpose.marketing: Ads, campaigns, message campaigns, audiences, landing pages and where to advertise; budget raises need the owner.
purpose.website: Menus, pages, blog and how the shop looks.
purpose.money: Profit and loss, COD, payments, refunds and the month-end close.
purpose.reports: Sales, delivery, product and customer reports from the same definitions, and the site's health.
purpose.ai: What the AI may do, its approvals and its costs. AI is off until the owner turns it on.
purpose.settings: Store-wide things only; everything else sits in its own section.
purpose.help: The Bengali guide for every section, and the build progress.

guide.title: {section} — guide

palette.placeholder: Type a page, setting, order no., phone, product…
palette.hint: > actions · # order · ? help · Bengali words work

palette.error: Search could not run. Try again.

ntf.title: Notifications
ntf.emptyNote: Nothing has happened yet that needs telling.
ntf.note: Notifications are things that happened once. Live work waiting for you is on the Dashboard under “Needs you now”.

newDevice.title: Staff sign-in from a new device

seasonal.stopped: Seasonal home: a look was stopped

notfound.title: Page not found
notfound.body: The link may be old. Search finds every page and setting.

error.title: This page could not load
error.body: Nothing was changed. Try again; if it keeps happening, send the error id to the team.

denied.title: You don’t have access to this page
denied.body: It needs the permission “{perm}”. Ask the owner to add it to your role.
denied.bodyPlain: Ask the owner to add the permission this page needs to your role.

closed.title: Closed by the owner for now
closed.body: {section} is part of stage {stage}, which the owner has closed until it is finished. Nothing built here is lost: it comes back when the owner opens the stage again.
closed.bodyPlain: The owner has closed this part until it is finished. Nothing built here is lost: it comes back when the owner opens it again.

unavailable.title: This server has no database connected yet
unavailable.body: The admin opens once the database is connected.

placeholder.title: {section} moves here next
placeholder.body: This section is being built in the new design, one page at a time. Nothing here is a sample.

todo.title: What to do now
todo.sub: {n} lists · most urgent first · a task leaves by itself when it is done
todo.clearNote: New work shows up here by itself, most urgent first.
todo.asideNote: Use the clock on a task to look at it in {n} hours.

lm.undone: Done — it is back as it was.
lm.undoFailed: Could not undo. Open the page and check.
lm.chartHelp: move over the chart, or focus it and use the arrow keys, to read each point
lm.noData: No figures for this time yet.
lm.failed: That did not work. Nothing was changed; try again or open the page.
lm.someFailed: {n} of {of} done. Open the rest one by one.
lm.bulk: What to do with the ticked rows
lm.publishOff: Publish turns on when every line above is ticked.
lm.previewEmpty: The name shows here as you type
lm.askSure: This changes how the shop works for buyers. Are you sure?

saveErr.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to change this. Ask the owner to give your role the right.
saveErr.NOT_FOUND: This is not there any more. Reload the page.
saveErr.UNAUTHENTICATED: You have been signed out. Sign in again, then save.

help.title: Help & manual
help.sub: Every section's guide, in Bengali. The same guides open from each page.
help.askLine: Something the shop cannot do yet? Most changes need only a switch, a Smart Rule or a key; for a truly new function, ask for it here. The build team puts it in the PR register and builds it.

dsh.smoothNote: The lines show a {n}-day average, so one busy day does not hide the trend. Point at a day for its own number.
dsh.noneFinished: No parcel has finished in the last {n} days yet

guide.title: Where the guide opens
guide.sub: On a computer or tablet the guide can open beside the page, in its own small window, or as a full page.
guide.phone: On a phone the guide always opens as a full-screen sheet.
guide.note: The choice is saved now. Until the guide’s next step is built it still opens as a side panel.

theme.title: Admin look
theme.sub: How the admin looks to you: the look, light or dark, the accent colour and motion. Buyers never see any of this.
theme.plannedNote: Not built yet; it is built when the owner asks for it.
theme.modeNote: Only for you. The moon button at the top does the same.
theme.accentNote: Buttons, links and highlights take this colour; text on it is kept readable.
theme.motionNote: Stops the count-ups, the chart drawing in and rows sliding away, only for you. Your device's own setting is always followed too.
theme.motionTeamNote: Off as shipped. Each person can still reduce it for themselves.
